title: The White Tower of Languedoc
summary: The great fortress of the Order of Reason.

claims.text: Few may pass the Seven Rings, the outer works and three inner fortress walls around the White Tower; standing openly at its doors implies courage and the trust of a high Resplendent.
The three inner walls are castles in their own right, holding kitchens and stables; outside them stand eight halls, one for each Convention and one left empty.
A palisade, an earth rampart and a ditch circle the hill, making seven rings that stand for the seven Conventions, and learned Daedaleans count the tower walls as an eighth.

title: Paracelsians and Elementalists
summary: The great medical quarrel of the Order.

claims.text: The ideas of Paracelsus are fought over more fiercely than those of Copernicus, since they attack the old theory of four elements behind medicine.

Elementalists hold that sickness comes from an imbalance of the four humors; Paracelsians teach that each organ works as an alchemist dividing pure from impure, and illness follows when an organ fails at it.

title: Lord Cabot's Grange
summary: A Council of Nine stronghold in England.

claims.text: The Cabots have ruled the Grange for centuries; it has a square moat, an herb garden, a hedge maze laid out to Lord Cabot's own design and a walk between rose beds.
A single wooden bridge, gated and guarded at all hours, crosses the moat and can be taken apart in minutes if a siege looms.

title: The Lickspittle Players
summary: A traveling troupe and independent covenant.

claims.text: Most of the Players come from England; they work north as far as Britain and the Low Countries in summer and take their wagons south to the Mediterranean when frost comes.
Lords sometimes invite them to perform for the nobility, but their usual audiences are laborers, craftsmen and merchants.
Karl Gertzwein, whose father was a Baltic sea captain, briefly trained as an Explorator in the Grail order before joining the Players at Nice and becoming their playwright.

title: Koraghissis
summary: A small island chantry of Disparate mages.

claims.text: Koraghissis is a small island with a good spring, olive trees and gardens enough for a small community, which trades for food with larger islands a day's sail away.
It is a subtle Cray; al-Khanan sometimes draws Tass from it as plain-looking beach sand.
About a dozen Disparate mages of mixed power live there in whitewashed cottages, a few holding laboratories and libraries, and members come and go freely.
